_comment: Human checklist for DQXI Studio. status = todo | partial | done. Weighted completion: done=1, partial=0.5. Edit freely; progress.py preserves this file and only creates it when missing.

features.title: Browse every converted asset family
features.notes: viewer_rs panels for models, textures, layouts, scripts, tables, audio, maps.

features.title: Browse and search readable native C
features.notes: Code panel reads decomp/ghidra; falls back to asm when the index is missing.

features.title: Load a level3d map with its environment mesh
features.notes: Editor panel loads game_assets/maps/<id>/scene.json plus the converted OBJ/glTF.

features.title: Edit placement transforms with undo/redo
features.notes: Position, scale and rotation edits; marker drag; undo/redo stacks.

features.title: Save editor project and export a patched BXON
features.notes: editor_projects/<map>.json and same-size level3d.patched.bxon.

features.title: One-click rebuild of a playable ROM from the editor
features.notes: Play button in the top bar opens Export & Play, which rebuilds and boots the mod.

features.title: Schema-driven table editor (items, monsters, spells, shops)
features.notes: Schema-driven tables panel: typed fields, text fields editable, undo/redo, Add entry (claims a placeholder row). Row-count growth unsupported (27 bound checks on 0xB3B).

features.title: Message/dialogue text editor with font-glyph check
features.notes: Dialogues panel edits message text, measures it with the game BFFNT glyph widths against the textbox and warns on missing glyphs/overflow.

features.title: Edit, recompile and validate Squirrel scripts
features.notes: Scripts panel edits the decompiled .nut and runs compile/pack jobs (tools/squirrel_*).

features.title: Replace textures, models and audio from the UI with validation
features.notes: Textures, models and audio panels replace assets through asset_jobs (validated, staged in mod/romfs); layouts: edit panes, add pane, in-game preview with the game font.

features.title: Play button: export and launch Azahar/Citra
features.notes: Export & Play panel: builds the Luma folder / .3ds / .cia and boots Azahar (third_party/emutest), optional save slot.

features.title: Ghidra high-level C for every entry point
features.notes: 18,748 decompiled of 18,787; 38 covered by a containing function, 1 unresolved.

features.title: Name every native function
features.notes: First pass covered every function; second (refine) pass R_007..R_082 running. See the functions badge for the named share.

features.title: Summarise what each function does
features.notes: Summaries merged into the readable C headers; quality follows the refine pass.

features.title: Replace native code with bit-matching C source
features.notes: 4 verified replacements (InitBss + 3 GetTalkParty wrappers) of 18,787.

features.title: Merge naming proposals into symbols and regenerate readable C
features.notes: tools/merge_names.py folds N_* and R_* outputs into the readable C; the dispatcher runs it after every naming batch.

features.title: Bit-matching reassembly of code.bin / .code / ROM
features.notes: tools/build.py reproduces the retail SHA-256; the full test suite guards it.

features.title: Same-size ROM patch with verified RomFS IVFC hashes
features.notes: tools/patch_game.py; size-changing edits still need a full RomFS rebuild.

features.title: Luma3DS LayeredFS mod folder export
features.notes: python -m tools.export_mod --target luma (also from Export & Play).

features.title: Rebuild a full playable .3ds from modified assets
features.notes: --target 3ds rebuilds the Level-3 RomFS metadata and hashes, so added/resized files work.

features.title: Export a .cia for real hardware
features.notes: tools/ctr_cia.py, byte-identical to the translation project builder; installs via FBI on CFW. Real-hardware run still to be confirmed by the user.

features.title: Task-oriented modding documentation
features.notes: docs/: GETTING_STARTED, EDITING, EDITOR, ASSETS, AUDIO, CODE, SCRIPTS, EXPORT, REBUILD, TESTING_EMULATOR, SOURCE_REPLACEMENT.

features.title: "First mod in 10 minutes" guide
features.notes: docs/FIRST_MOD.md.

features.title: In-editor project tour
features.notes: Tour button in the top bar (or DQXI_TOUR=1) walks through every section in the editor; long form in docs/PROJECT_TOUR.md.
